added_claims.claim: The Treasury Secretary nomination helped shift markets away from the initial post-election view that the new administration means higher inflation and yields.

added_claims.direction: yields lower after a market-friendly nominee

added_claims.speaker: Graham Robertson
added_claims.quote: people tend to buy those when V's high oh I should have had that let's get it in the portfolio now and the bleed is terrible it's really costy
added_claims.claim: Investors buy tail-protection/long-vol strategies after volatility has spiked, i.e. when protection is most expensive, and then suffer heavy carry bleed.
added_claims.indicator: VIX level at time of long-vol allocations; option carry
added_claims.direction: long vol bought after spikes underperforms
added_claims.testable: yes - long-vol fund flows vs VIX level and subsequent returns

added_claims.speaker: Niels Kaastrup-Larsen
added_claims.quote: I also think about uh Trend following that usually when we really make a lot of money is when we have concentrated portfolios right so again with higher risk higher Vol comes the reward
added_claims.claim: Like Druckenmiller's concentrated bets, trend followers make their big gains when the portfolio is concentrated in a few large positions; higher risk and volatility come with the reward.
added_claims.testable: yes - trend returns vs portfolio concentration/effective number of bets
